messages:
incident-bot: CRITICAL: GPU pool exhausting in prod-eu (eu-west-2). queue=600, p99 latency=1.4s. Autoscaler reports repeated attach failures, paging oncall.

lee: ack. i'm oncall. calling ops and infra to war room.

anya: i'm seeing a huge spike on /api/v1/chat for model-xlarge-gpu. proxy returning 502/504 on retries. customer impact: two orgs flagged (GeoMaps, VaultPay).

ops: pulling autoscaler logs now, past 8 errors:
```
Error: ApplyLaunchTemplateVersion failed: LaunchTemplateVersionMismatch: referenced version 0 does not exist
Error: InstanceProfile lacks iam:PassRole permission
Error: TaintApplyError: malformed taint key "gpu-true"
```

lee: ugh: LT mismatch, IAM passrole, and taint key format. three independent blockers. priority: stop user-facing errors, then get capacity.

infra: for quick relief i can spin up a rescue nodegroup using lt-rescue-v1 with validated IAM. that'll add GPUs in ~5-8m. also can we route non-essential traffic off the GPU pool? product-soc can we drop background/low-priority jobs?

product-soc: yes. we can flip routing rules for low-priority tags. recommend shifting 90% of background-gen to cpu-fallback. keep premium traffic to GPU.

lee: please do routing first. infra, create nodegroup and post the node names here.

infra: routing change applied: cpu-fallback <- 90% for jobs labeled "background". watching metrics.

support-bot: pinged CS and account leads for GeoMaps & VaultPay. telling them we are actively mitigating and will follow up with timeline.

ops: rescue nodegroup created: rescue-gpu-1729 nodes: rescue-1,rescue-2,rescue-3. they are booting. autoscaler controller still noisy for nodegroup-gpu-main attempting to scale and failing, i'm suspending scaling for that ASG.

anya: metrics: queue dropped from 600 -> 240 in 3 mins after routing. 5xxs reduced but still above baseline.

ops: kube events show taint application errors on newly created nodes that used old taint syntax. looks like a recent config drift changed expected taint format in the autoscaler. copying event:
```
Warning  FailedTaint  30s kube-controller-manager  failed to add taint "gpu-true:NoSchedule" to node node-old-12: invalid key format
```

lee: note that a CI change last night (#4317) normalized taint keys, but nodegroups created earlier still use old key. we need compatibility check. create a short-term fix: accept both taint formats in the controller or sanitize on node join. who can patch? infra or ops?

infra: for fast fix i'd rather revert the taint normalization in config and roll a hotfix to the autoscaler validation; but that takes time. immediate: i'll annotate nodes with legacy taint key and remove taint requirement so pods can land on rescue nodes.

ops: rescue nodes Ready. pods scheduling now. token latency falling to ~500ms. queue ~90.

lee: suspend failing ASG, cordon its nodes so scheduler doesn't try placing new pods there. ops, can you do that?

ops: suspended ASG scaling for nodegroup-gpu-main. cordoned and drained nodes where safe. observed a few PersistentVolume attach errors during drain; left those for stateful pods to be relocated.

product-soc: quick mitigation outcome: GeoMaps saw degraded period ~10m, VaultPay ~6m. both accounted for, no SLA breach yet. CS will follow up with post-incident note.

infra: opened PR to revert taint-format change and to add terraform validation that LT versions exist before apply (PR #4332). tagging ci and security for iam:PassRole enforcements.

ops: added runbook snippet to suspend ASG and create manual nodegroup. pasting commands:
```
# suspend scaling
aws autoscaling suspend-processes --auto-scaling-group-name nodegroup-gpu-main --scaling-processes Launch\n# create rescue nodegroup
eksctl create nodegroup --cluster prod-eu --name rescue-gpu --node-type g4dn.xlarge --nodes 3
```

lee: checklist: 1) routing applied 2) rescue nodegroup created 3) failing ASG suspended 4) taint revert PR open 5) customers notified. owners: infra(PR/revert), ops(rescue & ASG suspend), product-soc(routing), support-bot(customer comms).

anya: we're back to normal queue ~25, p95 latency ~210ms. monitoring shows steady state.

oncall-rotation-bot: reminder: handoff in 40m. lee, assign backup if you plan to remain in war room.

support-bot: incident INC-2026-209 created and logged. customer messages sent.\n
lee: resolving page since metrics stable. will keep thread as reference for postmortem. thanks all. :tada:

oncall-rotation-bot: PAGE RESOLVED by lee at 15:05:01 UTC.

infra: actions for postmortem: add taint-format linter to CI, add LT existence check to terraform plan, require iam:PassRole in instance profile policies. target postmortem doc in 3 working days.

ops: archiving logs, will attach autoscaler controller excerpts and node events to the incident ticket.

product-soc: will follow up with feature team to reduce GPU usage spikes during batch window.\n
lee: closing thread in 20m unless anyone objects.
